Local compatibility changes for Variant Lab:
Aioli: added execIO with real file descriptor stdin/stdout/stderr and returned process status.
Emscripten JS loaders: expose exit(status) as Module.__exitStatus.
Tool WebAssembly binaries are unchanged.
Upstream: https://github.com/biowasm/biowasm and https://github.com/biowasm/aioli

Tool module reset after each GNU utility/Bowtie2 invocation prevents stale C globals and getopt state.
